title: 第七章 想来就来，想走就走吗？
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
正在孔梁吃惊之时，他发现，那边，那个年轻人的目光迎了过来。

    长相清秀，目光看过来的时候，并无太多敌意，只是带着几分打量。

    但就是这样，也让孔梁的心中惊骇莫名！

    这个人，他的身上甚至都没受一点伤？

    而旁边的那只一阶凶兽，就已经躺在血泊当中，明显已经被他处理掉。

    这得是什么样的实力？

    哪怕身为荒野猎人，孔梁也不认为自己能轻易做到这种地步。

    这样的实力，可是比他一开始闯进此人领地的时候，预想到的强太多了！

    同时，他的心中也浮现出了一个名字！

    秦天！

    秦天！！！

    作为玩家中还算不错的职业，他的心中一直都是有相应的目标和计划的，所以早在初期，他就想办法利用自己能够获得的较为稀缺肉类，尽可能和其他的玩家交换材料，想要升级领地。

    但哪怕如此，

    结果，后来在系统公告下，他得知有人居然在这么短的时间内，就已经成功将领地升级，变成了二级领地。

    心中惊叹之余，他当时也记下了这个率先激活二级领地的领主的名字。

    就叫秦天！

    他很有印象，并且在心中早就已经将此人当做目标，只是不知道他觉醒的是什么天赋，居然能有这么夸张的提升速度。

    而眼前所见到的这一幕，他几乎在瞬间就在心里想到了这个名字。

    眼前这个人，如果能够以这么轻松的方式就战胜这只凶兽，那么他的身份，只有可能是那个升级成二级领地的秦天！

    他的心中震惊莫名，被秦天这样看一眼，整个人都从头凉到脚！

    这样一个可以一个人就单刷凶兽的领主，哪里是他可以惹得起的？

    所以现在被这样看了一眼，他心中直接就是震惊，然后才反应过来。

    此人的慌乱，秦天这边也能大概感受到。

    不过他倒是没有立刻要将这人给抹杀的想法。

    要是他有这种想法的话，早在此人踏入他的领地之时，他就已经完成对这家伙的绞杀了。

    这人能活着到他面前，亲自见到他，都已经是他网开一面，特地给他留了一命的结果。
content_en:
When Kong Liang was surprised, he found that the young man's eyes were coming over there.

    He had a delicate appearance, and when he looked over, there wasn't much hostility, just a bit of sizing.

    But even this made Kong Liang feel inexplicably horrified!

    This man didn't even have any injuries on his body?

    The first-order ferocious beast next to it was already lying in a pool of blood, and it had obviously been dealt with by him.

    What kind of strength does this have?

    Even as a wilderness hunter, Kong Liang didn't think he could achieve this easily.

    This kind of strength is much stronger than what he expected when he first broke into this person's territory!

    At the same time, a name also appeared in his mind!

    Qin Tian!

    Qin Tian! ! !

    As a fairly good profession among players, he has always had corresponding goals and plans in mind. Therefore, as early as the early days, he tried to use the scarce meat he could obtain to exchange materials with other players as much as possible in order to upgrade his territory.

    But even so,

    As a result, he later learned through the system announcement that someone had successfully upgraded the territory to a second-level territory in such a short period of time.

    While marveling in his heart, he also wrote down the name of the lord who was the first to activate the secondary territory.

    Just call Qin Tian!

    He was very impressed, and had already regarded this person as a target in his mind, but he didn't know what kind of talent he had awakened, and he could actually improve at such an exaggerated speed.

    And seeing the scene before him, he thought of the name in his mind almost instantly.

    If the person in front of him can defeat this ferocious beast in such an easy way, then his identity can only be that Qin Tian who upgraded to the second level territory!

    He was inexplicably shocked. Being looked at by Qin Tian like this made him feel cold from head to toe!

    How could such a lord who could kill ferocious beasts alone be able to offend him?

    So now that he was looked at like this, he was immediately shocked, and then he reacted.

    Qin Tian could also roughly feel this person's panic.

    However, he had no intention of killing this person immediately.

    If he had this idea, he would have finished strangling this guy as soon as he entered his territory.

    The fact that this person was able to come to him alive and see him in person was the result of him opening his eyes to others and specifically sparing him his life.
title_en: Chapter 7: Come when you want, leave when you want?
